mapper.insert: insert into task_comment ( task_comment_no, task_no, project_member_no, task_comment_content, task_comment_ctime, task_comment_utime ) values ( #{taskCommentNo}, #{taskNo}, #{projectMemberNo}, #{taskCommentContent}, systimestamp, null )
mapper.select: select tc.task_comment_no as taskCommentNo, tc.task_no as taskNo, tc.project_member_no as projectMemberNo, tc.task_comment_content as taskCommentContent, tc.task_comment_ctime as taskCommentCtime, tc.task_comment_utime as taskCommentUtime, e.emp_no as empNo, e.emp_name as empName, e.emp_dept_no as empDeptNo, e.emp_position_no as empPositionNo from task_comment tc inner join project_member pm on tc.project_member_no = pm.project_member_no inner join emp e on pm.emp_no = e.emp_no where tc.task_no = #{taskNo} order by tc.task_comment_ctime asc
